ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Atul Auto Limited has formally notified the exchanges and shareholders about its upcoming 38th Annual General Meeting (AGM) on September 18, 2026, and provided the web-link for the FY2025-26 Annual Report and AGM notice, particularly for shareholders without registered email addresses to ensure regulatory compliance. The most material impact is the reiteration of the SEBI mandate requiring physical shareholders to update their KYC details (PAN, bank, nomination, signature) to be eligible for future electronic payments, effective April 1, 2024. This document represents a routine regulatory compliance filing and does not contain any immediate financial red flags or unusual corporate actions.
